role.zh: 360 算法高级研究员 · 基础大模型团队负责人
role.en: Senior algorithm researcher · Foundation-model team lead, 360

intro.zh: 我从事基础模型、后训练、大模型安全、RAG、记忆与 Agent 系统的研究与工程工作。也关注技术路线、团队建设，以及研究成果如何在真实业务中长期发挥作用。
intro.en: I work on foundation models, post-training, LLM safety, RAG, memory, and agent systems. Alongside research and engineering, I care about technical direction, team building, and making research useful in real-world systems.

text.zh: 长上下文、数据选择、蒸馏、强化学习、模型融合与高效推理。
text.en: Long-context modeling, data selection, distillation, reinforcement learning, model merging, and efficient reasoning.

text.zh: 动态攻防、安全对齐、在线防护、幻觉治理与评测方法。
text.en: Adversarial evaluation, safety alignment, online protection, hallucination governance, and evaluation methodology.

text.zh: 文档理解、多文档证据、长期状态、经验复用与 Agent 工作流。
text.en: Document understanding, multi-document evidence, long-term state, experience reuse, and agent workflows.

role.zh: 基础大模型团队负责人 · 算法高级研究员
role.en: Foundation-model team lead · Senior algorithm researcher

text.zh: 负责基础模型、后训练、安全与可信生成、RAG、记忆和经验系统等方向的技术研发与团队协作。
text.en: Research and team leadership across foundation models, post-training, safety, trustworthy generation, RAG, memory, and experience systems.

management.zh: 连接研究问题、模型训练、系统工程与线上交付；推动多个方向的技术协同。
management.en: Connecting research questions, model training, systems engineering, and delivery across multiple technical areas.

role.zh: 数据智能与 AI 应用团队管理

text.zh: 涉及企业搜索云、数据智能、AI+VR 和智能应用，经历跨职能团队的搭建与管理。
text.en: Work on enterprise search, data intelligence, AI+VR, and intelligent applications, with cross-functional team building and leadership.

management.zh: 技术职责跨越算法、工程和产品交付，协调不同专业背景的团队。
management.en: Responsibilities spanning algorithms, engineering, and product delivery, coordinating teams with different specialties.

role.zh: 搜索问答、智能语义与对话

text.zh: 围绕搜索问答、语义理解、人机对话与大数据智能进行研发。
text.en: Research and development in question answering, semantic understanding, dialogue, and data intelligence.

management.zh: 连接自然语言处理研究和搜索产品工程。
management.en: Connecting natural-language research with search-product engineering.

text.zh: 汽车业务开发与推荐系统。
text.en: Automotive product engineering and recommendation systems.

management.zh: 积累面向业务场景的开发与推荐系统实践。
management.en: Building experience in product engineering and recommendation systems.

summary.zh: 以 Branch-Merge Distillation 探索紧凑模型的推理能力。
summary.en: Exploring compact reasoning models through branch-merge distillation.

problem.zh: 如何在较小模型规模下保留高质量的推理能力，并让方法可供研究者复用？
problem.en: How can compact models retain strong reasoning ability while making the method accessible to other researchers?

role.zh: 模型训练与发布；论文作者列表以 L Sun 开头。具体共同一作、通讯作者身份另行核验。
role.en: Model training and release; the supplied author list begins with L Sun. Equal-contribution and corresponding-author designations are not inferred.

approach.zh: 围绕推理路径与蒸馏展开，采用 Branch-Merge Distillation。Preview 推理模型与后续安全模型分别记录。
approach.en: The work explores reasoning paths and branch-merge distillation. The preview reasoning model is kept distinct from later safety-model releases.

result.zh: 形成 TinyR1-32B-Preview 技术报告与公开团队发布记录。北京大学计算机学院的报道明确列出孙林为 360 团队成员。
result.en: A TinyR1-32B-Preview technical report and public team-release record. PKU’s institutional article explicitly names Lin Sun as a 360 team member.

title.zh: 大模型安全与可信生成

summary.zh: 连接动态攻防、安全对齐与在线治理的研究和工程实践。
summary.en: Research and engineering connecting adversarial testing, safety alignment, and online governance.

problem.zh: 面对持续变化的越狱攻击、风险内容和幻觉问题，如何兼顾防护效果与正常任务体验？
problem.en: How can protection against evolving jailbreaks, harmful content, and hallucinations preserve useful task performance?

role.zh: 材料记录的职责包括技术路线、关键算法、模型训练、系统设计与落地推进。论文以公开作者列表为准，不把团队评测成绩表述为个人独立成果。
role.en: The supplied professional history records responsibility for technical direction, methods, model training, system design, and delivery. Paper attribution follows the author lists, and team evaluation results remain team outcomes.

approach.zh: 攻击生成 → 自动评测 → 安全训练 → 在线防护 → 经验回流。相关研究包括 TriPlay-RL 与 Magic-Token 安全控制；公开分享讨论场景化的幻觉与可信治理。
approach.en: Attack generation → evaluation → safety training → online protection → experience feedback. Related work includes TriPlay-RL and Magic-Token safety control, with public discussions of scenario-specific hallucination governance.

result.zh: 公开材料覆盖安全训练方法、团队内容安全方案与个人技术分享。业务调用量尚未建立可公开追溯口径，暂不展示。
result.en: Public records cover safety-training methods, the team’s content-safety solution, and personal technical talks.

label.zh: 可信 AI 媒体采访

summary.zh: 从视觉文档、证据分配到复杂信息场景中的可靠问答。
summary.en: From visual documents and evidence allocation to reliable answers in complex information workflows.

problem.zh: 检索与 OCR 结果并不总能形成可靠答案。如何利用多份文档中的有效证据，并理解文档噪声的影响？
problem.en: Retrieval and OCR quality alone do not guarantee reliable answers. How can systems allocate evidence across documents and account for document noise?

role.zh: 技术路线、系统方案、评测与业务落地推进。具体论文角色保留待核验状态；正文与作者列表分别提供证据。
role.en: Technical direction, system design, evaluation, and delivery. Paper-specific author roles are verified separately from the project responsibilities.

approach.zh: 结合知识检索、文档结构、证据分配与生成评测。相关论文覆盖 OCR-RAG 鲁棒性、BEAR 多文档证据分配和 TextlessRAG 视觉文档问答。
approach.en: Combining retrieval, document structure, evidence allocation, and generation evaluation. Related papers cover OCR robustness for RAG, budgeted multi-document evidence allocation, and visual-document RAG.

result.zh: 形成多个公开研究条目与 360 智脑 RAG 团队技术文章。团队榜单成绩、系统能力与个人研究贡献分别表述。
result.en: Public research records and a team technical article on 360’s RAG system. Benchmark outcomes, product capabilities, and personal research contributions are attributed separately.

title.zh: 记忆、经验与 Agent 系统

summary.zh: 围绕长期状态、任务经验与真实 Agent 工作流的持续探索。
summary.en: Exploring long-term state, reusable experience, and realistic agent workflows.

problem.zh: 如何跨对话保持状态、从任务反馈中复用经验，并理解 Agent 的效果与运行环境之间的关系？
problem.en: How can agents preserve state, reuse experience from feedback, and account for the effect of runtime environments on performance?

role.zh: 推进长期记忆与经验复用方向的技术工作，参与相关研究。完整作者顺序和个人署名角色按原论文核验，不由截断列表推断。
role.en: Technical work on long-term memory and experience reuse, with participation in related research. Complete author order and role designations are checked against the papers rather than inferred from truncated lists.

approach.zh: Mem360 面向长期用户状态与个性化；经验服务面向任务复盘与反馈复用。关联研究包括 Harness-Bench、MemAudit、ArborMem 与经验服务。
approach.en: Mem360 concerns long-term user state and personalization; experience serving concerns task reflection and reusable feedback. Related research includes Harness-Bench, MemAudit, ArborMem, and experience serving.

result.zh: 公开条目覆盖 Agent 工作流评测、记忆安全和经验服务。产品记忆、研究基准与部署研究分别说明。
result.en: Public records span agent-workflow evaluation, memory security, and experience serving, with clear distinctions between product memory, research benchmarks, and deployment studies.
